title: Add an HTML comment at the very top of index.html, before <!

messages.content: Add an HTML comment at the very top of index.html, before <!doctype html>, that reads: <!-- pipeline test -->

<<<PATCH path="index.html">>>
<<<<<<< SEARCH
<!-- pipeline test -->
<!doctype html>
=======
<!-- pipeline test -->
<!doctype html>
>>>>>>> REPLACE
<<<END PATCH>>>

last_error: index.html: patch #1: SEARCH block not found in file. First line: '<!-- pipeline test -->'
